idea-plugin.name: Droidle - Daily Android Quiz
idea-plugin.description:
Start your Android dev day with a 5-question quiz — right inside Android Studio.

Droidle brings a native daily Android quiz tool window to your IDE, synced seamlessly with droidle.dev.

  • 5 Daily Questions: Covers Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Architecture, Android Internals, and AI Prompting.
  • Cross-Platform Sync: Sign in with GitHub to sync your daily progress, XP, and streaks between Android Studio and the web leaderboard.
  • Bilingual Support: Instant Turkish (TR) and English (EN) language toggle for questions, explanations, and reference links.
  • Daily Reminder: Optional startup notification balloon so you never lose your streak.
